items.stem: An AI-drafted progress report states a concrete package is 90% complete, but the site diary and photos show the pour has not started. What should the planner do?

options.text: Correct the report to match verified site records before issuing it
options.rationale: Correct: reported progress must reconcile with the actual site records.

options.text: Issue the 90% figure because the AI produced it
options.rationale: An AI figure that contradicts site evidence must be corrected, not published.

options.text: Delete the site diary so the figures agree
options.rationale: Altering records to fit a wrong figure is improper.

options.text: Assume the photos are wrong and the AI is right
options.rationale: Verified site records take priority over an unverified AI claim.

items.explanation: Correct: reported progress must reconcile with the actual site records.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices make AI-assisted site reporting reliable? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Reconciling AI-drafted status against site diaries, photos and the baseline
options.rationale: Correct: reconciliation against real records keeps reports honest.

options.text: Recording the project manager's review and sign-off on the report
options.rationale: Correct: a sign-off record maintains accountability for what is published.

options.text: Publishing look-aheads without checking the programme logic
options.rationale: Unchecked logic can produce an unbuildable plan.

options.text: Reporting delays with no supporting evidence
options.rationale: Delay narratives need records to be credible and defensible.

items.explanation: Correct: reconciliation against real records keeps reports honest.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A planner asks AI to draft a two-week look-ahead. What is the correct way to use the draft?

options.text: Treat it as a first draft to review against the programme and site constraints
options.rationale: Correct: AI drafts speed up planning but must be checked against real constraints.

options.text: Issue it to the trades unchanged because AI planned it
options.rationale: Unreviewed look-aheads may ignore real site constraints.

options.text: Assume it overrides the baseline programme
options.rationale: A look-ahead supports, it does not silently replace, the baseline.

options.text: Use it only if it contains no activities
options.rationale: A useful look-ahead contains activities; the point is to review them.

items.explanation: Correct: AI drafts speed up planning but must be checked against real constraints.
